obligation: G072 -- multi-plane Metal GEMV, measured GB/s against the kernel classes
kernels: qwen_binary_planes_k{1,2,3}_matvec_geo_tpr64_tg128 -- one kernel loading k planes together, sharing the geo_tpr64 address math, accumulating per-plane scales in registers, never materializing a reconstruction buffer
roof_basis: the roofline sweep in the SAME run peaks at 595.9 GB/s at low arithmetic intensity, so that is the ceiling these kernels are scored against rather than a figure from another day
replication: re-run on the protected lane before contradicting a recorded claim. The plane kernels replicate at 0.11 / 0.44 / 1.25% and q3 at 0.03%. CAVEAT: q4_group64 (the non-hgravu variant, not used by any candidate) replicated at 31.08%, so the replication was NOT uniform across the whole table and only the rows quoted here are being relied on.
verdict_on_the_recorded_claim: The recorded finding -- 'all six variants are MEMORY-BOUND at 639.25 GB/s and none becomes compute-bound at any plane count, so plane count is free on the arithmetic axis' -- SPLITS rather than simply failing, and the split is the useful part. It is TRUE from k1 to k2: the second plane costs +10.2% time for 2x the code bytes, because it rides activations already loaded, and bandwidth climbs 206.3 -> 374.5 GB/s. It is FALSE from k2 to k3: bandwidth is flat at 374.5 -> 380.0 GB/s, so the kernel is saturated at its own ceiling and time now scales with bytes -- 1.5x the bytes for +47.8% time. Plane count is free until the kernel saturates, and it saturates at TWO.
the_real_gap: None of these kernels is memory-bound in the sense of sitting at the roof. q4 reaches 593.4 GB/s = 99.6% of the measured 595.9 GB/s ceiling, while the plane kernels top out at 380.0 GB/s = 63.8%. The multi-plane GEMV leaves 36% of the bandwidth its own family already achieves on the table. Closing that gap would put k2 at 0.4275 ps/element, half of q4's. That is the named remaining lever on this kernel.
independent_agreement: G069 set the ladder's stopping point at TWO planes from the DENSITY side -- marginal error reduction per unit ALU collapses 4.35 -> 0.56 at plane three. This measurement reaches the same k=2 from the KERNEL side, because that is exactly where the bandwidth saturates. Two independent routes to the same number.
binding_status: NOT BOUND to the decode path, which is G071's obligation and is blocked on a packer. This obligation's verify asks for measured GB/s against the kernel classes, and that is what is delivered.
